title: Low-Resource Neural Machine Translation: A Conditioned Evaluation of TransA and TransB (SYNTHETIC)

paragraphs.text: We evaluate two translation models, TransA and TransB, on the low-resource benchmark LowMT-100 under a 10k sentence-pair training budget.
TransB was previously reported to achieve 41.2 BLEU on the high-resource WMT benchmark [7].
All models are trained on the LowMT-100 training split consisting of 10,000 sentence pairs and evaluated with BLEU on the official test split.
TransA achieves 32.4 BLEU on LowMT-100, while TransB achieves 29.8 BLEU under the same low-resource condition.
TransA therefore outperforms TransB by 2.6 BLEU points on LowMT-100 under the 10k-pair condition; the LSTM-M baseline reaches 24.1 BLEU.
We hypothesize that TransA's advantage stems from its deeper encoder, though this requires further ablation.
